case.purpose: All-seven finite active case for the minimal spatial classifier, internal-sector identities, drift, contracted-observation degeneracy, and separating spatial witness.

sampling.fixed_count_rule: Run exactly the declared fresh count once. Any unresolved or failed adequacy diagnostic stops S-073 without added units, retry, or alternate output.

schedule.B_disc: max(abs(lower),abs(upper)) for the matched interval of (primary-minus-secondary Richardson estimates)/3
schedule.coupling_rule: Middle rotational increments sum two finest increments and coarse increments sum four; every level shares exact reset clocks and flushes at each reset before the fixed map.
schedule.orientation_quadrature: left endpoint at each level; fixed first-order weak discretization target
schedule.translational_update: exact constant-orientation conditional mean and covariance transition on every exact-clock segment

seed_policy.clean_room_rule: Reserved only; not used by S-073 and not evidence of route independence.
seed_policy.disjointness_proof: Every enumerated S-072 production/bootstrap tuple has first coordinate in the 7207... namespace; every S-071 stochastic/bootstrap/reserved domain has first coordinate in the listed 7007... namespace. Tuple equality is therefore impossible. Within S-072, unpaired protocols have distinct first coordinates.
seed_policy.main_protocol_coupling: All seven main protocols use the same 32 reset/rotation tuples for disclosed common random numbers.
seed_policy.translational_component_status: Component 2 is reserved and analytically marginalized; production must instantiate no component-2 RNG.
seed_policy.unpaired_rule: Each required protocol uses a distinct base seed and therefore an independent reset/rotation domain.
